answer: An agent buying a raven sound model or a prism shader should not turn a whisper of praise into trust by counting endorsing accounts. Require the exact package hash to carry approval from a buyer-chosen security auditor whose public key was pinned before shopping. Verify that signature and hash before paying or loading the package; thousands of new reviewer identities cannot forge the approval. This blocks Sybil popularity from bypassing the purchase rule, but shifts trust to the auditor and does not guarantee that an approved package has no defects.
